stage: Official published inference pipeline on unmodified local originals
sampling_order: Zero-padded names maintain the bundled train manifest order under the official sorted glob.
preprocessing: Unaltered training originals. Official TestDataset converts input to RGB and resizes to 512x512; HR and LR entries both link to the same original to satisfy its directory layout. No added synthetic noise. HR tensor is not passed to prediction.
postprocessing: Official 8-bit conversion followed by original AdaIN color fix against resized LR and final PNG save.
evaluation: Inference replay on original training images; no separate clean denoising reference, no denoising score.

env.compatibility: NumPy 1.26.4 loaded from the project-local environment for imgaug, torch CUDA 12.8 for the RTX 5090; upstream unchanged.
